title: Fix regression in governance approval queue projection and status handling

ac_1_exclude_terminal_decisions_from_que.detail: approval_owner.list_decisions applies pending_only=True filtering to prevent decided, approved, or rejected decisions from leaking into /api/v1/operator/governance/approval-queue; decision_type filter matches target_type.

ac_2_project_queue_item_shape.detail: approval_owner.project maps queue items in one place to include decision_type, submitted_by, allowedActions, and decision_context matching the PKT-006 contract while preserving decision fields.

ac_3_dependency_unavailable_on_invalid_o.detail: router._forward catches ValueError, AttributeError, and TypeError alongside network errors, converting malformed or non-list owner responses into HTTP 503 DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE instead of 500.

ac_4_no_regressions_and_passing_tests.detail: Every test in test_pkt006_approval_queue_contract.py (2 passed), test_bff_approvals_surface_contract.py (11 passed), and test_governance_router.py (7 passed) passes cleanly without call_owner leaks.

ac_5_test_expectation_classifications.detail: Each changed test expectation is classified as retired, stale_sample, intended_change (with deciding commit), or real_regression_fix backed by production code.

ac_6_line_budget_and_formatting.detail: Production code diff is +31 net lines against origin/dev, well below the 50 net line budget, with no compressed code used.

test_governance_router:test_governance_q.description: Approval queue total updated from 2 to 1 and items[0].decision_id asserts approval-1. Decided approval-2 with state approved is terminal and excluded from queue per AC1; backed by production fix in approval_owner.py/router.py pending_only=True.

test_governance_router:test_consultation.description: Expected redacted_evidence_count updated from 0 to 1 due to canonical fail-closed default evidence redaction policy introduced in 45b6d66ab for /api/v1/consultations/{session_id}/evidence. No production change in this PR backs this expectation.

test_governance_router:test_review_and_g.description: POST /bff/reviews expectation updated from 202 accepted to 410 ACTION_RETIRED. Route was retired to HTTP 410 in 499a8adc0 (and dab9aa6c2). No production change in this PR backs this expectation.

test_bff_approvals_surface_contract:samp.description: Sample _BINDING_APPROVAL_PENDING decision_state updated from pending to proposed. In canonical governance owner model, pending is a meta-category (_PENDING = {'proposed', 'under_review'}) rather than a concrete owner state.
Sample _KILLSWITCH_APPROVAL_REVIEWED decision_state updated from reviewed to under_review. Aligns with canonical governance owner in-review state representation.

test_bff_approvals_surface_contract:stat.description: Expectations for decision_state and state alias query params updated to match canonical state projection (proposed returns 2 items, under_review returns 2 items, pending returns all 4 pending items). Backed by production AC1/AC2 filtering.

test_bff_approvals_surface_contract:deci.description: assert sorted(ids) == ['apv-consdata-001', 'apv-filter-003'] ensures deterministic order-independent comparison for multi-item result when decision_state=proposed overrides state=under_review.
